orders.instruction: Preserve the credited two-level solver. Probe the first unsolved level online, identify where its state or action assumptions break, and add a level-specific rule. Verify progress after each action and avoid repeating failed state-action pairs.

Adapt sc25's credited cell to this untried keyboard-click game. Probe available actions and component responses online; learn which donor state features and action rules transfer. Replace mismatched mappings with observed rules and target the first level's completion condition.

summary: Fill all three slots: extend two proven solvers and transfer a credited solver to an untried game. Budget is 58%; stop launching writers at 85%.
